answer: The lantern cap is checked at intake and echo shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a onyx tag. The deposit is 64 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
